target.side_naming: anatomical: L/R are the character's left/right

aws_baseline.segmentation: SeeThrough V3: LayerDiff 3D plus body-part parsing
aws_baseline.repair_inpainting: Bounded inpainting crops only after SeeThrough output QA
aws_baseline.policy: Never stop or modify unrelated processes; recheck free VRAM before each GPU job

groups.name: tail
groups.notes: Reconstruct the portions hidden behind the torso and legs. Preserve the dark maroon outline and color.

groups.name: back_hair
groups.notes: Each long lock must have hidden root coverage behind the head and shoulder.

groups.name: lower_body_preserved
groups.notes: Separate enough to preserve a future full-body upgrade; do not spend V1 rigging time below the hip.

groups.name: torso
groups.notes: White top must include coverage behind both arms and the collar. Keep garment shading as source pixels where visible.

groups.name: arms
groups.notes: Keep as separately movable artwork, but no hand tracking in V1. Fingers remain grouped per hand unless deformation tests require a split.

groups.name: head_base
groups.notes: Face base must be reconstructed under all bangs. Ears need hidden inner coverage for small head angles.

groups.name: brows
groups.notes: Recover full brow shapes behind bangs so expressions do not expose cut edges.

groups.name: eye_L
groups.notes: Reconstruct a complete iris/white behind the lids. Closed lid is new reviewed artwork, not a SeeThrough extraction.

groups.name: eye_R
groups.notes: Match the left eye structure while preserving source asymmetry. Do not mirror blindly.

groups.name: mouth
groups.notes: Source neutral mouth remains authoritative. Interior, teeth and tongue are new reviewed artwork for open states.

groups.name: front_hair
groups.notes: Split by natural strand boundaries. Every moving strand needs root overlap and clean alpha without white background fringe.

seethrough_mapping.eyelash: eyes, then split L/R and upper/lower
seethrough_mapping.irides: eyes, then split L/R and iris/pupil/highlights
seethrough_mapping.objects: belt and shoulder accessories; review manually

hidden_coverage: full forehead and face beneath front hair
complete eye whites, irises and pupils beneath lashes
neck and white top behind hair and arms
hair roots behind head, shoulders and arms
tail continuation behind torso and legs
qa_gates: Neutral reconstruction matches the source at native resolution
No visible light-background fringe on transparent edges
No missing eye, mouth, finger, hair or tail pixels
Every moving layer has sufficient hidden overlap
No generated region is accepted without a visual comparison
PSD layer names are unique and retain canvas alignment
Head-angle extremes do not expose holes beneath hair
Blink and mouth transitions do not double or ghost
VTube Studio receives blink, gaze and lip-sync parameters
